params.body:
Fixes bevinding de-schadekeuze-per-wagen-komt-niet-aan.

The per-vehicle customer-mode modal posts `with_damage`. The controller read `width_damage`, a field
that does not exist, so `intval(null)` gave 0. Worse, that 0 was written over the session key
`stocklist_client_mode_marge_damage`: choosing "met schade" on the overview and then saving this
modal for one vehicle switched damage back off without anyone asking.

That is visible, not cosmetic. `CustomerModePrice::showsDamage()` drives two things: the damage block
on the detail page, and the two "met schade" buttons in the action column (offer and order). They
disappeared after saving, in front of a customer.

The other modal, `client_vehicle_index_mode`, read the field correctly the whole time, which is why
the overview behaved and only the per-vehicle save undid it.

Two of the three tests fail against the controller on main with "Failed asserting that 0 is identical
to 1", the second one on the sentence that matters: the choice from the overview has to survive.

**Found through a different report, and the other half is still open.** Shane said a price changed in
customer mode did not change the price on the detail page. That is a separate thing and it is not in
here: on an **own** vehicle `detailPrice()` returns the retail price before it ever looks at the typed
price, so R S5-4.5 quietly beats R S5-4.6. Whether that is right is a question for Ilse, and it is
named in the finding rather than decided here.
params.title: The damage choice arrives, and does not undo the one from the overview
